title: Puzzle2d Theme Chrome Sync
description: puzzle2d sometimes shows light theme including window options while rest of UI is dark. Ensure theme cannot desync in any UI.
summary: Fixed intermittent light-themed puzzle2d canvas and window controls when the shell was dark. Root cause was nested surface-chrome subscribers each removing `html.dark` on cleanup while another lease stayed active, plus theme applying in useEffect after first paint. Implemented a reference-counted lease stack in @ui/react, useLayoutEffect for hook subscribers, color-scheme on html/body, and safer puzzle2d CSS token probes. Added regression tests in @ui/react.
